title: The final deniability game excludes dependence of the real record on the decoy opening
releaseBlockingReason: Blocks the unqualified claim that the full deniability experiment of the text is formalized; an explicitly narrower theorem can still be published.
reproduction: Inspect realRecords' type and draw order. It receives genuine P/E/tables and is sampled before the disclosed usage record. For a fixed genuine context with distinct phrases, let U be a fresh fair Boolean and let the broader real-record rule copy the realized U record.
expected: The text permits the real wallet to be used in any way. The source-faithful final game can therefore sample a genuine record conditional on the realized decoy Q/state/record, as EasyCrypt dReal does.
observed: The final Lean kernel supplies none of those realized decoy arguments. Its real record is conditionally independent of fresh U; the two Boolean records agree with probability 1/2, versus 1 for the allowed copy rule. The averaged theorem does not remove this restriction: usage is fixed outside Setup.
impact: A concrete experimental family allowed by the text is outside the checked final Lean theorem. This is not a counterexample to its numerical advantage bound or evidence that the broader bound is false.
evidence: Direct final-signature and program-body trace; independent deniability review and skeptical record-kernel challenge; exact conditional-law witness in the report.
recommendedFix: Extend the accepted-branch genuine-record kernel with the decoy Q/state/realized U record, then lift existing pointwise clean-run equality and refusal composition. Alternatively publish the narrower record restriction explicitly.
requiredVerification: Kernel-check an endpoint with the broader kernel and unchanged numerical bound; include a shared-record Boolean instance distinguishing the original and extended games, and preserve lookup/budget/refusal behavior.

title: The documented kernel-replay loop returns success when replay fails
releaseBlockingReason: Repair status propagation before advertising the command as automated kernel verification.
reproduction: Substitute lake with a function that returns 7 and run the literal loop over two synthetic Lean filenames.
expected: Any failed module replay makes the verifier exit nonzero and records the failed module.
observed: Both FAILED messages print, but each echo succeeds and the loop returns 0.
impact: Automation can report acceptance after every replay failed. The audit's separate recorder/guard preserves failures and its actual kernel results are unaffected.
recommendedFix: Use a verifier with explicit nonzero aggregate status or fail immediately while preserving the actual module/code.
requiredVerification: A failed stub must produce nonzero overall status; all current fresh artifacts must pass a correctly propagating loop.

title: Complete-coverage wording needs the remaining domain and exact-statement qualifications
affected: Publication README.md:4-6,38-41; Chapters/README.md scope; final W5/W6/W7 and ancillary result index.
reproduction: Compare every numbered and rigorous unnumbered claim against its actual endpoint and inherited Fintype/totality hypotheses.

title: The native-evaluation axiom explanation describes an older Lean mechanism
reproduction: In the pinned toolchain, compile a separate true native_decide theorem, print/check its axiom closure and invoke the actual checkpoint gate.
expected: The trusted-base description names the mechanism used by the pinned toolchain.
observed: Lean 4.35 creates a dedicated _native...ax declaration; the README says native_decide would appear as Lean.ofReduceBool. The actual general allowlist correctly rejects the dedicated axiom as well.
impact: A reader relying only on the obsolete marker could misunderstand native-proof trust. No native proof was found in the reviewed development and its gate remains effective.
evidence: Pinned upstream Meta/Native.lean and official 4.35 release notes; NativeControl checkpoint rejection.
recommendedFix: Describe the complete transitive axiom allowlist and version-correct native-generated axioms, without relying on one obsolete name.
requiredVerification: The README agrees with the actual NativeControl axiom name and the gate still rejects all non-allowed axioms.
